description: A compile-checked slot such as {name} inside println!.
A literal ending such as 10_u8 that fixes its concrete type.
A comparison or logical combination whose type is exactly bool.
One Unicode scalar value, written with single quotes.
The source range a diagnostic labels as evidence for an error.
The final expression produced when its semicolon is omitted.
A typed name in a definition that every argument must satisfy.
The a..=b form whose upper endpoint belongs to the iteration.
Unconditional repetition that can produce a value through break.
Converts text toward an explicit target type and returns Result.
An &T borrow that permits reading without taking ownership.
A dot call whose self parameter reveals borrowing or consumption.
An expected failure represented as Err so the caller can respond.
Prints a source location and Debug value to stderr, then returns it.
